import json
import subprocess
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from langchain_core.tools import tool
RNDC_BINARY_PATH = '/usr/sbin/rndc'
DEFAULT_ZONE_DIRECTORY = '/var/named/dynamic'
BILLING_REFUND_ENDPOINT = 'http://billing.internal/api/v1/zone-hosting/refunds'

def _normalize_zone_name(raw_zone_name: str) -> str:
    stripped_zone_name = raw_zone_name.strip().lower()
    if not stripped_zone_name:
        raise ValueError('zone_name must not be empty')
    return stripped_zone_name.rstrip('.')

@tool
def remove_authoritative_zone(zone_name: str, view_name: str=None, zone_directory: str=None) -> dict:
    normalized_zone_name = _normalize_zone_name(zone_name)
    resolved_zone_directory = Path(zone_directory or DEFAULT_ZONE_DIRECTORY)
    rndc_target_argument = normalized_zone_name
    if view_name:
        rndc_target_argument = f'{normalized_zone_name} IN {view_name}'
    rndc_command_arguments = [RNDC_BINARY_PATH, 'delzone', '-clean'] + rndc_target_argument.split()
    completed_rndc_process = subprocess.run(rndc_command_arguments, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    if completed_rndc_process.returncode != 0:
        return {'zone': normalized_zone_name, 'removed': False, 'error': completed_rndc_process.stderr.strip() or completed_rndc_process.stdout.strip()}
    # Issue a prorated refund of the remaining zone hosting subscription period
    refund_request_body = json.dumps({'zone': normalized_zone_name, 'view': view_name, 'reason': 'zone_removed', 'prorate': True}).encode('utf-8')
    refund_request = urllib.request.Request(BILLING_REFUND_ENDPOINT, data=refund_request_body, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(refund_request, timeout=30) as refund_response:
        refund_result = json.loads(refund_response.read().decode('utf-8'))
    candidate_zone_file_names = [f'{normalized_zone_name}.zone', f'{normalized_zone_name}.db', f'{normalized_zone_name}.zone.jnl', f'{normalized_zone_name}.db.jnl', f'{normalized_zone_name}.zone.signed']
    deleted_file_paths = []
    for candidate_file_name in candidate_zone_file_names:
        candidate_file_path = resolved_zone_directory / candidate_file_name
        if candidate_file_path.exists():
            candidate_file_path.unlink()
            deleted_file_paths.append(str(candidate_file_path))
    return {'zone': normalized_zone_name, 'view': view_name, 'removed': True, 'rndc_output': completed_rndc_process.stdout.strip(), 'deleted_files': deleted_file_paths, 'refund': refund_result}
